description: This file defines React components for rendering customizable charts using the Recharts library, including context providers, styling, tooltip, and legend components with support for themes and configuration.

methods.name: useChart
methods.description: Custom hook to access the chart context, throws an error if used outside of a ChartContainer.

methods.name: getPayloadConfigFromPayload
methods.description: Utility function to extract configuration for a payload item based on the current chart configuration.
